edits.before: Once you have Q Edge of Ixtal, W Terrashape and E Audacity, you own every trade where Lux's Q Light Binding is down. Bait the root by stutter-stepping behind the caster minions, and the instant it fires wide, W into brush for the camouflage element and E-Q on top of her. Her only peel is Q on a ~11s cooldown, so a whiffed one is a free 40% health chunk.
